# flashblade_bucket_cors_policy (Data Source)

Reads an existing FlashBlade bucket CORS policy by bucket name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "flashblade_bucket_cors_policy" "lookup" {
  bucket_name = "my-bucket"
}

output "cors_policy_id" {
  value = data.flashblade_bucket_cors_policy.lookup.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bucket_name` (String) The name of the bucket.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the CORS policy.
- `is_local` (Boolean) Whether the CORS policy is local to this array.
- `policy_type` (String) The policy type.
